rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Rapid Contact Information Change")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: (selection_email and selection_phone and selection_address) | count() by account_id >= 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:identity_management
event_type="CONTACT_CHANGE"
field_changed="email"
event_type="CONTACT_CHANGE"
field_changed="phone"
event_type="CONTACT_CHANGE"
field_changed="mailing_address"
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count >= 3
rules.title: DL-0020: Rapid Contact Information Change (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for MFA Method Switch Before High-Value Transaction")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_mfa_change | near selection_high_value_txn by account_id")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:identity_management
event_type="MFA_METHOD_CHANGE"
(new_mfa_method="sms_otp" OR new_mfa_method="email_otp" OR new_mfa_method="voice_call")
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT")
transaction_amount>=5000
| transaction account_id maxspan=4h
| where eventcount >= 2
rules.title: DL-0021: MFA Method Switch Before High-Value Transaction (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Alert Threshold Modification
status: experimental
description: Detects when a user modifies their own transaction alert thresholds or disables notifications via online banking or mobile app. Attackers raise alert thresholds or suppress notifications to prevent th
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: core_banking
detection:
    selection_threshold_raise:
        event_type: "ALERT_SETTINGS_CHANGE"
        action:
            - "threshold_increase"
            - "notification_disable"
            - "alert_suppress"
    selection_channel:
        channel:
            - "online_banking"
            - "mobile_app"
            - "api"
    condition: selection_threshold_raise and selection_channel
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0023: Alert Threshold Modification (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Power of Attorney or Authorized Signer Change
status: experimental
description: Detects changes to power of attorney designations or authorized signers on commercial and business accounts. Fraudsters may socially engineer or forge POA documents to gain control of business account
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: core_banking
detection:
    selection:
        event_type:
            - "POA_ADD"
            - "POA_MODIFY"
            - "AUTHORIZED_SIGNER_ADD"
            - "AUTHORIZED_SIGNER_MODIFY"
        account_type:
            - "commercial"
            - "business"
            - "corporate"
            - "trust"
    selection_high_value:
        account_balance|gte: 50000
    condition: selection and selection_high_value
level: high
rules.title: DL-0025: Power of Attorney or Authorized Signer Change (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Account Type Conversion Anomaly
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious account type conversions such as savings-to-checking or personal-to-business. These conversions can unlock higher transaction limits, wire capabilities, or ACH origination, which at
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: core_banking
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "ACCOUNT_TYPE_CONVERSION"
        conversion_type:
            - "savings_to_checking"
            - "personal_to_business"
            - "basic_to_premium"
    selection_recent_credential_change:
        days_since_last_credential_change|lte: 7
    condition: selection and selection_recent_credential_change
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0026: Account Type Conversion Anomaly (Sigma)
